title: This Is The Start of Something BIG...
speaker: Jared (Click Capital)

macro_themes.theme: AI boom not a bubble yet
macro_themes.view: Compute demand still outstrips supply (GPU rentals, Taiwan/Korea exports rising), so a burst is unlikely in the next ~8 months.
Neocloud debt yields are rising partly from heavy issuance and strong growth, not only credit risk; some neoclouds may be bottoming.
Gains mostly from earnings growth, forward P/E ~19 and multiples compressed, so valuations aren't stretched.
A dicey week or two into the midterms, then stocks usually rise; October dips in strong years are buyable into Christmas/January.
Oil may be forming a double top as Hormuz traffic recovers to 80-90% and US-Iran/Ukraine peace talk grows.
High yields reflect strong growth as much as inflation; the US economy easily absorbs a ~5.1% 10-year.
French unrest and record borrowing costs make French stocks/bonds uninvestable for him.
